team.summary: Founders have strong technical depth (PhD-level in mathematics/ML) and Rand Hindi has prior startup experience and an exit (Snips acquired by Sonos). However, Mael Primet and Michael Fester lack clear prior startup or exit signals. Overall founder-market fit is moderate for an edge-based voice solution given their deep tech background.

founders.name: Rand Hindi
founders.background: Co-founder and CEO; deeptech entrepreneur/investor, former CEO of Hinran, co-founder of PlanetUltra (French social network). Prior startup experience; after Snips was acquired by Sonos, founded Zama.

founders.name: Mael Primet
founders.background: Co-founder and CTO; mathematician, PhD-level technical co-founder. No clear prior startup or exit signal found.

founders.name: Michael Fester
founders.background: Co-founder; pure mathematics student at Cambridge University, one of three PhD founders. No clear prior startup or exit signal found.

team.technicalDepth: High; all three founders have PhD-level backgrounds in mathematics/ML, enabling ownership of core model/integration layer.

product.plainLanguage: Edge-based private voice solution for OEMs.

risks.text: Product is a B2B OEM solution, not a self-serve SMB product; likely requires heavy sales/implementation.
Founded in 2013; traction signal is stale (funding raised years ago, no recent active usage or paying customer data).
No clear defensibility beyond edge privacy; potential dependence on horizontal platforms (e.g., Sonos acquisition suggests platform lock-in risk).

subScores.label: Team
subScores.rationale: Strong technical depth and one founder with prior exit, but two founders lack startup/exit signal; founder-market fit is moderate for edge voice.

subScores.label: Defensibility
subScores.rationale: Edge privacy provides some differentiation, but no evidence of proprietary data, network effects, or workflow lock-in; risk of dependence on OEM partners.

subScores.label: Product
subScores.rationale: AI-native agent? Unclear if end-to-end action; not self-serve for SMBs (OEM-focused); one-liner is clear but not action-oriented.

subScores.label: Market & Why-Now
subScores.rationale: No credible size hint, no why-now driver identified, no competitive landscape provided.

subScores.label: Traction / Freshness
subScores.rationale: Only stale signal: founded 2013, $18M funding; no recent paying customers, active usage, or launch activity.

scoreRationale: The startup shows strong technical depth but lacks recent traction, clear market sizing, and product-market fit for the stated thesis. Defensibility is weak and the product is not self-serve. Overall, it does not score well against the rubric.
